listing.name: Complete Vanilla Overhaul Mod Pack
listing.summary: Overhauls vanilla balance, including ships, skills, leveling, economy, and fleet doctrines.

description:
Disclaimer:

SpoilerEven though this mod is playable on 0.98, it was designed for 0.97

Fringe Worlds will most likely function somewhat equally to the way it does in 0.97

But Fever Dream Balancing and Horrible Weapons will not due to extensive fixes to the AI that took place. And thus have improved a variety of things. Such as Hardpoint weapons accuracy

This project is also somewhat concluded, but feel free to add anything if you want to

Generally, I have completed this as an experiment. And came to a conclusion that vanilla Starsector is very good in its subtelty and suffering. And that removing those elements whilst interesting, took away of the majority of that finesse.

There is some cool *** here nonetheless. And I hope you have fun. I am working now on modifying the vanilla experience in more subtle ways[close]

Download link:

https://github.com/Limieczeczerz/STARSECTOR-OVERHAUL-PACK/releases/download/Starsector/Fever.Dream.Balancing.archive.zip

GAMEPLAY FOOTAGE

(dated, because the mod has been updated a lot since then, but I'm keeping this cause it's hard to make)

This modpack contains 3 mods

- Starsector PROCGEN overhaul Fringe Worlds

- Starsector balance overhaul Fever Dream Balancing

- Starsector HORRIBLE WEAPONS pack which contains 2 new ships, 1 fighter and 1 new weapon wing to be used by Core World factions

FRINGE WORLDS:

Completely overhauls Starsector system creation system and some Core World systems as of now

Spoiler(lava planet texture given as a royalty free asset by pixi rice bowl)

[close]

Fever Dream Balancing:

Completely overhauls vanilla balance, including ships, skills, levelling, economy, etc.

Horrible Weapons:

Adds Mithrill Midline Battleship, Hellrose kinetic DEM, Tri-Tachyon Enforcer and Cactus Fighter Wing

Spoiler[close]

Horrible Weapons rebalanced for vanilla standard download link

https://github.com/Limieczeczerz/STARSECTOR-OVERHAUL-PACK/blob/main/Horrible%20Weapons%202B-c%20(vanilla).zip

Current Issues:

- i am very tired

- Check if you can make new enemies added with 0.98 update to be easier to play against whilst retaining what is interesting about them and not making them a cakewalk

- Investigate changed descriptions of various planets you have made

02.04.2025

- Ported to 0.98

- Nerfed added Core Worlds a bit. Moved them a bit too (this is to prevent them from looking like self-inserts)

- Removed False Prophet and Death Lord colonies

- Added a new system called Abbadon. A distant Persean League system

- Reworked Tyle (is that what it's called? I'm sorry if I... I'm sorry) into a trinary system with a black hole, a blue giant and a brown dwarf

- Nerfed Warthog, Broadsword and Cactus by giving them finite flux instead of very high flux venting stats

- Increased Centurion's armour by 150 and hull durability by 1k to justify its 5 DP cost

- Lowered Hound's flux capacity by 500

- Reworked Anubis. Has 0.7 shields, costs 30 DP, significantly reduced Design Compromises penalties. Increased base hangar bays from 1 to 2. MIGHT BE OVERPOWERED! FEEDBACK APPRECIATED

- Edited descriptions a bit

- Reverted Fulgent and Glimmer now have High Energy Focus again. Fulgent is 11 DP. Lumen now has plasma jets

- Modified the new Brilliant variant to be Tachyon Lance focused, as the default one was already Paladin PD focused

- Unnerfed Devastator to shooting 6 projectiles again

- Removed additional lava planet variants from spawning pool. They still exist, but they will no longer randomly generate

- Restored the base lava variant to default look from vanilla as the new look is clashing too much with the game's artstyle

HOTFIX 27.03.2025

- Not reuploading the whole batch, just fringe worlds was replaced in the current one

- Added specific conditions to one of the planets in populated worlds

- Reverted Null's and Fameless' descriptions to past ones which were better and less confusing

- Fixed some typos specifically in the Yendore system

24.03.2025

- Gave Aurora 0.6 shields and a singular hangar bay to have something to use its spare OP on after it has had its large missile removed

- Reverted Destroyers being 2 DP cheaper. They are now all priced similarly to vanilla

- Exceptions are Drover (12 DP), Harbinger (14 DP)

- Changed lower Remnant's systems. Fulgent and Glimmer now have plasma jets. Lumen's mobility has been greatly increased, and it now has High Energy Focus

- AMB reverted to having vanilla firerate

- Plasma Cannon reverted to having simply twice as slower firing mechanics in favour of higher projectile damage. But at the cost of slower projectile speed as it was a few patches ago

- Changed Heavy Mortar to fire 4 projectiles again

- Nerfed Phase Lance by decreasing its turn rate by 33%

- Shifted flux stats of civilian ships a little. For example reduced flux venting of Tarsus by 50

- Reduced flux venting of Condor by 50 from the buffed value

- Reduced flux capacity of Vanguard, Hound, Cerberus by 500 from the buffed value

- Increased flux capacity of Wayfarer by 500

- Increased Gemini's flux capacity by 1k and flux venting by 50

- Changed the probability of ruins occurring on planets to now be increased by stuff like habitable. But reduced the chance of it occurring overall

- Changed the volatile and organics boost to now be tied to cold and very cold instead of poor light and dark

- (previously unmentioned) reduced Flux Regulation and Crew Training to their vanilla values

- Removed B-Deck from Scintilla

- Restored AI tip for Temporal Shell that fools it into thinking it has bonus movement speed (though I inputted a different value, should probably revert it to vanilla next time)

-

Rebalanced PTS values for cruisers and capital ships again to make them appear more sporadically in NPC generated fleets. Making bounties and other kinds of encounters more easy to deal with

edit:

Forgot to mention:

- Mercenary military doctrine has been increased to be maximum size so that they no longer break story encounters with how weak they are

23.03.2025

- Reverted increase to logistical potency of civilian ships

- Increased durability by increasing flux, armour and hull strength of various civilian ships to make early game more survivable when caught off guard

- This will also make it more difficult to earn a lot of money from transporting goods missions

- Changed colony growth through hazard pay to now put above 20 and cost 2k per point. Instead of 40 with 4k per point

- Changed Orbinoptic from being a Pather world to a Luddic Church one

- Reworked Mining Blaster to work the exact same way it used to, but now it does 800 damage per shot instead of 600 (as in before it was reworked to be an anti-armour weapon). It now has 600 range, and its turn rate is only 20% slower than that of Heavy Blaster. Instead of more than 40%

- Nerfed Swarmer by halving its fire rate. Nerfed Locust by halving its fire rate as well

- Nerfed Annihilator by reducing their fire rate to vanilla

- Nerfed DEM missiles. Halved their flight time

- Reworked Gorgon to work the same way it does in vanilla except with high explosive damage through beams. It fires for twice as long as it does in vanilla. With each Gorgon dealing 1600 damage over the duration of 2 seconds

- Hydra has received the same treatment

- Increased Gorgon's OP cost to 5. Gorgon now launches 2 projectiles the same way Gorgon Pod does. With it having 4 projectiles total

- Hellrose was reworked/nerfed to cost 18 OP, have 7 projectiles. Each of them dealing 5k kinetic damage instead of 10k

- Buffed Kite by reducing its DP to 2, halved cost

- Buffed Shepherd by reducing its DP to 3

- Reverted Advanced Ground Support and standard Ground Support to their vanilla state

- Put a few more stable locations with installations on them here and there in the Core Worlds and Secondary Worlds

- Fixed an issue with Ripper's Morld solar array going out of position over time

- Nerfed Heavy Mortar back to its vanilla state

- Nerfed Chaingun back to having vanilla damage, but 600 range

- Nerfed Autopulse, TPC and Ion Pulser by doubling their recoil. Autopulse and Ion Pulser now have vanilla spread. With TPC having twice the vanilla spread. Doubled TPC's ammo to compensate

- Nerfed PD Burst and Heavy Burst damage to vanilla values. Halved their ammo capacity to vanilla values

- Nerfed Plasma Cannon to having DPS similar to that of vanilla. Charge up and in-between shot times are that of vanilla. But the cooldown between salvos was made significantly longer. Flux efficiency changed from 1.2 to 1.1 to compensate

- Reworked Dual Autocannon by making it into vanilla state, but with old flux efficiency of every shot costing only 30 flux instead of the vanilla value of 40

- Fixed an issue with Remnants not having reduced campaign speed values as it was intended to be in the mod

- Decreased respawn timer of Warthog's to 10 seconds. And of Cacti to 15 seconds

- Nerfed Cacti by halving their turn rate and turn acceleration. They will now do proper attack runs instead of getting stuck on top of the enemy

- Buffed AMB by it now having 7.75 in-between shots timer. Instead of 10.25

- Rebalanced civilian PTS values. There will now be more shuttles and lower size crap available in shops for example. With larger ones being more rare

- Changed how Colossus works by making Pather variant cost 9 DP, and carrier variant 10 DP. But they now have higher armour and flux stats. They have 200 more armour. 1000 more flux and 100 more flux venting. Reverted cost to vanilla

- Increased Condor's flux capacity and venting by 1000 and 100

- Fixed an issue with Augmented Drive Field displaying an s-mod description in spite of it being nerfed into no longer being possible to be built-in into a ship

- Increased the amount of random person bounties around the universe

- Buffed Displacer to have 500 range instead of 300... Again

- Buffed Teleporter to have 25 seconds cooldown, but no longer utilises charge mechanics

- Kinetic Blaster now works the same way it does in vanilla, but has 50 more damage. Being at 300 now instead of 250

20.03.2025

- Doubled the amount of scavenged resources to pre-nerf value. Now drops 250% more resources than in vanilla with a larger to credit conversion retained

Hotfix:

- Reverted Microburn to the vanilla state

- Halved the assumed by AI range of Orion Device and Nova Drive. This affects the AI and doing this will encourage Nova and Retribution to use the drive more aggressively

- This will in turn make these ships suicidal again. As these measures were taken to act against microburn AI being moronic. But I think it's better to overestimate than to underestimate

15.03.2025

- Reduced the amount of Lagrange points

- Increased the strength of fringe colonies to make them less vulnerable to pirates

- Added a Luddic Church station in Bzabzen

- Added an independent station in Parkapec

- Overhauled a bunch of Core World systems to have more Lagrange points, better structure. Might actually be worse in some cases. Cause it was stupid to rework them. But some things had to be done, I

…
